resolution.description: Resolution of the final video. Width and height must be between 512 and 2048.
resolution.title: Resolution

resolution_aspect_ratio_video_index.description: Zero-based index of the input video whose aspect ratio should be used when resolution is not provided. If omitted, preserves the default behavior of using the minimum width and minimum height across input videos.
resolution_aspect_ratio_video_index.title: Resolution Aspect Ratio Video Index

target_fps.description: Target FPS for the output video. If not provided, uses the lowest FPS from input videos.
target_fps.title: Target Fps

video_urls.description: List of video URLs to merge in order
video_urls.title: Video Urls

metadata.description: Metadata about the merged video including original video info
metadata.title: Metadata

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

height.description: The height of the generated image.
height.title: Height

width.description: The width of the generated image.
width.title: Width
